notes.title: Credits updated with an announcement of the next game
notes.content:
[h2]Next game..![/h2]
The credits now feature a button to sign up for a newsletter about upcoming games.

[h2]Humble beginnings[/h2]
Lemonade Apocalypse was made during a Gamejam. Its length, limited mechanics and so forth is a result of that.
Well! Now there's a new version in the works. I hope you look forward to making impactful choices, new mechanics, a meaningful prestige system and many different endings!

[h2]Links[/h2]
The button leads to this link:
https://forms.gle/L6reyPHiitc3XqpP9

There's also a Discord server, should you be so inclined :)
https://discord.gg/v2b5HRufzd


Please subscribe to the newsletter if this interests you! I promise I won't spam. You can unsubscribe at any point.

May humanity prevail and not succumb to forces of greed,
Geir

notes.title: July 21st (Sunday) Fixes
notes.content:
Hi all!
Fixes should work now.

[h3]Muting sounds and music[/h3]
Should actually work and persist through levels. Let me know though if you should still have issues.

[h3]Windowed mode[/h3]
Is accessible at the cog wheel in the upper right corner (can be accessed from the start screen, and in all levels).

Thank you for the continued reports, I hope you keep reporting :)

notes.title: 10/4 (Wednesday) Hotfix
notes.content:
Hi all!

Some bugfixing and windowed mode have been implemented:

[h3]Windowed mode[/h3]
Can be accessed in the cog wheel (Click the 2nd button in the cog wheel menu)

[h3]Bug fixes[/h3]
[list]
[*] Mute persists through all levels now.
[*] Glass now actually costs 0 after Lemonade Machine have been bought.
[/list]

Thank you for the reports, and please continue letting me know of occurances of bugs and other QoL improvements as I will continue fixing these things.
